Version 1.0.3

phy-cron-explainer 1.0.2

- Metadata version updated to 1.0.2 in SKILL.md.
- No functional or documentation content changes.

- Updated author information to "Canlah AI"
- Added homepage link: https://canlah.ai
- Bumped version to 1.0.1 in metadata
- No changes to core functionality or user commands

- Initial release of phy-cron-explainer.
- Explains any cron expression in plain English and lists the next 5 scheduled run times.
- Validates cron syntax, detects impossible/conflicting expressions, and identifies suspicious scheduling patterns.
- Converts plain English descriptions to cron expressions and vice versa.
- Supports all major cron flavors: standard Unix, 6-field with seconds, AWS EventBridge, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes CronJob, Spring, and special strings.
- Scans and audits cron schedules in .github/workflows/ and Kubernetes YAML files—all parsing done locally with no external API calls.
